title: Too many problems
body:
1. Use Generative AI art. 
Imagine building an app and can’t pay for some picture or graphic, which also show ur unprofessionalism, laziness, and the lack of creativity in “creating an app” when ur app is literally just a cheap knock off of others.
2. All service are behind a pay wall.
I understand the lack of funding or whatsoever but if I can not try the app then how am I gonna know if the features are worth it? Yes there is a refund option but you can not expect me to do a lot of unnecessary processes for an app with no promise of anything better than the other thoudans free apps out there. 
3. The concept of “solo leveling”
A good point for attracting those who love the series and make people feel like they are a part of it tbh but it got backfired by how you execute the app.
